reviewer: Codex AI source comparison, not independent expert adjudication
scope: All 22 displayed Day 20 recovery claims. Not an exhaustive biomedical or clinical accuracy assessment. No new labels were sent to the model.

assessment_categories.textual_or_answer_scope_error: Explicit source/target mismatch observed by AI inspection; may include answer relevance rather than a false literal fact.
assessment_categories.scope_uncertain: Required scope is absent or an omission risk exists; not proof that the underlying clinical claim is false.
assessment_categories.no_specific_issue_identified: This inspection identified no specific issue; not a correctness label.
